numos.name: NUMOS
numos.slogan: Simplifying the creation of dynamic digital assets

home.title: Bring Digital Assets to Life
home.description: Create dynamic NFTs in the easiest way possible and launch in days.

example.title: Try it out!
example.description: Get the plant to fully grown and healthy by using the actions on the left.

architecture.title: Easy, but incredibly powerful
architecture.description: Building with Numos is simple - your vision grows, and we grow with you. Our modular platform lets you create collections that evolve and expand seamlessly, adapting to your journey and ideas every step of the way.

action.title: Interact with your asset
action.description: Make your asset fun with custom interactions. Trigger them with a simple click, token activity, or anything else.

traits.title: Change traits with actions
traits.description: Define unique traits that set your assets apart and make them dynamic through interactions.

image.title: Update the image via traits
image.description: The image brings your NFT to life, so when traits change the image updates automatically.

highlights.title: Built for creators
highlights.description: We've got you covered from A to Z - all you need is your vision. Numos provides a one-stop solution with a complete infrastructure layer to support your idea. You bring the art, we'll bring the rest.

visualEditor.title: Create custom interactions visually
visualEditor.description: Effortlessly create dynamic NFTs with our intuitive node editor – simply drag, drop, and connect to bring your vision to life - no coding skills required.

modular.title: Modular design
modular.description: We have big plans for the platform, so we designed it to be modular and easy to extend even for existing collections.

control.title: Keep real control of your assets
control.description: You maintain full ownership and control over your NFTs, from creation to evolution. Define how your assets work and evolve on your terms.

infrastructure.title: Purpose built infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Whether you're starting small or dreaming big, our infrastructure scales effortlessly to match your needs while keeping your assets safe and secure.

benefits.title: Benefits of interactive NFTs
benefits.description: Bring your ideas to life with interactive and evolving NFTs—no coding required. Our platform empowers creators to design.

benefits.title: Commemoration
benefits.description: Create a permanent record of your users achievements and experiences.

benefits.title: Co-Creation
benefits.description: Make your users feel like they are part of the project. Give them a sense of ownership and involvement.

benefits.title: Progression
benefits.description: Encourage users to take their time and explore the project. Provide opportunities for them to learn and grow.

benefits.title: Rewards
benefits.description: Offer incentives and rewards to encourage users to engage with your project. This can be in the form of in-game items, virtual currency, or other rewards.

benefits.title: Gamification
benefits.description: Add a competitive element to your project. This can be in the form of leaderboards, rankings, or other gamification features.

benefits.title: Customization
benefits.description: Allow users to customize their experience. This can be in the form of different levels, skins, or other customization options.

benefits.title: Storytelling
benefits.description: Use your project to tell a compelling story. This can be in the form of narratives, dialogues, or other storytelling elements.

pricing.title: Predictable pricing
pricing.description: Always know what you're paying for, but never pay more than you need. We also offer custom pricing for larger projects and a full-service agency offering. Contact us for more information.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.description: Try out the studio, no extra steps required

tiers.name: Creator
tiers.description: Perfect for artists, creators, and small teams

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.description: Designed for professional teams and studios

team.title: Made by Apes, with love
team.description: We're passionate NFT believers. Our mission is to push the boundaries of this space, unlocking a new chapter for NFTs and redefining digital ownership together with you.

beta.title: Join the beta
beta.description: Join the beta to get early access to the platform and help shape the future of interactive NFTs.
beta.modalDescription: We'll only contact you for important updates
benefits: Be the first to try our studio
beta.disclaimer: Your inbox deserves to stay clean. We only send you the good stuff.
